content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy is a popular platform for creators, but it's not available in 150+ countries, including Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan. Its alternatives include the Edge Commerce Stack, which is a sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-stripe|The Full]] built on Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to options]]-ethiopian-digital-creators-only-real|payment]]s. This stack offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. It's a permanent structural alternative that bypasses traditional payment gateways and their restrictions. Additionally, there's the Sovereign Starter Stack, which is a more basic version of the Edge Commerce Stack, designed for creators who need a simple and easy-to-use solution. The Sovereign Blueprint is a comprehensive guide for users who want to build their own sovereign commerce infrastructure, and the Complete Builder Kit provides a set of pre-built templates and blueprints for advanced users.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

The Edge Commerce Stack and its components are designed to handle restricted countries by providing a sovereign commerce infrastructure that's not dependent on traditional payment gateways. This means that creators can sell their products and receive payments without being blocked by Stripe or PayPal. The NOWPayments integration is particularly useful, as it allows creators to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and process payments without being restricted by traditional payment gateways.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment speed and fees associated with the Edge Commerce Stack and its alternatives are relatively fast and low compared to traditional payment gateways. The NOWPayments integration, for example, charges a 0.5% fee for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, which is lower than many traditional payment gateways. Additionally, the Edge Commerce Stack provides a comprehensive guide on how to minimize payment fees and maximize revenue.
The Edge Commerce Stack is a comprehensive and easy-to-use solution for creators who need a sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of architecture depends on the creator's specific needs and circumstances. The Edge Commerce Stack is a good option for creators who need a comprehensive and easy-to-use solution, while the Sovereign Starter Stack is better suited for creators who need a simple and easy-to-use solution. The Sovereign Blueprint and Complete Builder Kit are good options for advanced users who want to build their own sovereign commerce infrastructure.
